import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd

# Load the data
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Plot the data
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='product', y='total', hue='is_takeaway', data=coffee_sales)
plt.title('Total Sales by Product and Takeaway Status')
plt.xlabel('Product')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales')
plt.legend(title='Takeaway Status')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
